content.text: In control-panel/public/index.html, the release-gate approval card treats every verdict that is not PASS as a regression (around line 419-420), so the new INCONCLUSIVE verdict (added to request_release_approval in tools/server.mjs v2 toolset) is shown as a red 'REGRESSION DETECTED'. Fix it: show three distinct states — PASS (existing green style), REGRESSION_DETECTED (existing red style), INCONCLUSIVE (new amber/warning style: add CSS tokens and a .verdict.inconclusive rule matching the existing pattern, text like '⚠️ INCONCLUSIVE — could not gather device evidence'). Keep the edit minimal and in the file's existing style. Verify by running: node -e that extracts nothing is needed; just re-read the changed lines. Then commit only that file with message 'Control panel: distinct INCONCLUSIVE verdict state' plus a blank line and 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>', and git push. Report the commit sha.

input.old_string: .verdict.regression { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad); border: 1px solid var(--bad); }
input.new_string:
.verdict.regression { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad); border: 1px solid var(--bad); }
  .verdict.inconclusive { background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn); border: 1px solid var(--warn); }
